description: Use when the customer describes a trip instead of a size: country (or up to 5), days and how they use data (usage light / normal / heavy, or gb_per_day). Sizes the data pool from the data guide and returns three server-quoted configurations per country — exact, comfortable (×1.5) and generous (×2) — each with its price, networks, a one-line reason and its buy_url, plus trip totals and an optional budget check. Prices are the same as quote_esim. Give destination (one country) or destinations (several) — one of the two is required; a call without a country fails with invalid_argument.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

budget.description: Optional budget for the whole trip in the quoted currency; options above it are marked.

days.description: Days of the trip (per country for a multi-country trip; 1–90).

destination.description: Country in ANY language or its ISO code, e.g. "Japan", "Japon", "jp". Map a city to its country first. One country per eSIM. Required unless destinations is given.

destinations.description: Several countries (max 5), any language or ISO codes. Use instead of destination for a multi-country trip. Required unless destination is given.

gb_per_day.description: Optional: the customer's own estimate in GB per day (wins over usage).

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

networks.description: Optional: operator names (or codes) from get_networks to include. Omit = the cheapest network of the country. The dearest included network sets the data price and every network beyond the first adds a small fee.

per_country.description: Optional days per country for a multi-country trip.

usage.description: light ≈ 0.5 GB/day, normal ≈ 1.5 GB/day (default), heavy ≈ 4 GB/day.

name: recommend_config
title: Recommend a configuration
